Today I am working on the installation guide.
Today's work is the installation guide. Give the team an update on your current focus.
Vandaag is fronted as one time constituent, so finite werk comes before ik. Werken aan names the task being worked on; present tense can describe current work.
Ik werk vandaag aan de installatiehandleiding.
Today I am working on the installation guide.

Yesterday I handled three outstanding tickets.
You handled three outstanding tickets yesterday. Report that completed work in the meeting.
Heb afgehandeld is the perfect of separable afhandelen. Gisteren places the action yesterday; three tickets is the object, while ik controls heb.
Gisteren heb ik drie openstaande tickets afgehandeld.
Yesterday I handled three outstanding tickets.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
S=We|V=zijn|C=bezig|PP=met de voorbereiding van de demonstratie.
Your team is currently preparing a demonstration. Describe that ongoing preparation to colleagues.
Zijn agrees with we. Bezig describes an ongoing activity and met introduces the noun phrase de voorbereiding van de demonstratie; this is not a completed perfect.
After this meeting, I am going to collect the test results.
You plan to collect the test results after the current meeting. State your next action.
Na dit overleg is one first constituent, followed by finite ga and subject ik. Gaan takes bare infinitive verzamelen for the planned action.
Ik ga na dit overleg de testresultaten verzamelen.
After this meeting, I am going to collect the test results.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
The check is not finished yet.
A check is still unfinished. Tell colleagues that it has not been completed yet.
Nog niet means not yet. Klaar is an adjective after is, with no -e; the sentence describes an unfinished state rather than a perfect verb form.
S=Mijn belangrijkste taak|V=is|C=de overdracht aan de avonddienst.
My most important task is the handover to the evening shift.
Your main task is handing over to the evening shift. Identify that priority in your update.
Mijn belangrijkste taak is singular with is. De overdracht is a noun complement naming the task; aan de avonddienst identifies the receiving shift.
S=Ik|V=verwacht|G=dat de controle vanmiddag klaar is.
I expect the check to be ready this afternoon.
You expect the check to be completed this afternoon, but cannot guarantee it. Express that expectation.
Verwacht states an expectation. Dat introduces its content; vanmiddag gives the expected time and klaar is ends the clause. Klaar means finished for this check.
PP=Voor de nieuwe test|V=heb|S=ik|O=nog een account|C=nodig.
For the new test, I still need an account.
You still need an account for a new test. Explain the outstanding resource requirement.
Voor de nieuwe test identifies the purpose, not a deadline. The fronted phrase is followed by heb ik; hebben ... nodig means need, with nog marking the remaining requirement.
Ik heb voor de nieuwe test nog een account nodig.
For the new test, I still need an account.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
Who is giving the first update today?
The team is about to start today's updates. Ask who is giving the first one.
Wie is the question subject, followed by geeft. Vandaag specifies the day; de eerste update is the object, and no additional subject is inserted.
There have been no new blockers since yesterday.
No new blockers have arisen since yesterday. Report that continuing absence to the team.
Er introduces existence; geen nieuwe blokkades is the plural subject, taking zijn. Sinds gisteren extends the state from yesterday to now, so Dutch uses the present here.
I have added the new steps to the manual.
You added the new steps to the manual. Report that completed documentation update.
Heb aangevuld is perfect with separable aanvullen. De handleiding is the document supplemented; met de nieuwe stappen identifies the material added.
The colleagues have checked the test accounts.
Your colleagues have checked the test accounts. Report who performed that completed check.
Plural de collega's takes hebben. Gecontroleerd is the participle, while de testaccounts is the object checked; the sentence does not give the check's outcome.
We have finished all the planned checks.
Your team has finished every planned check. Report the completion of that full set.
Zijn klaargekomen is the perfect of klaarkomen. Met alle geplande controles identifies the tasks finished; alle covers every planned check, not every possible check.
The latest version appeared yesterday evening.
The latest version appeared yesterday evening. Report that release time to the team.
Is verschenen is the perfect of verschijnen with zijn. Gisteravond gives the past time; appearing is not a passive action performed on the version.
I have requested the missing information from the user.
You requested missing information from the user, but have not necessarily received it. Report the request made.
Heb opgevraagd is perfect with separable opvragen. Bij de gebruiker identifies whom you approached; requesting information does not assert receipt of a reply.
We have compared the results with the previous report.
Your team compared the results with the previous report. Report that completed comparison.
Hebben vergeleken is the perfect of vergelijken. Met het vorige verslag gives the comparison reference; the sentence does not state that the results match it.
The installation is finished, but the check is still running.
Installation is finished, but verification is still running. Distinguish those two work states.
Maar coordinates two main clauses: de installatie is and de controle loopt. Klaar is an adjective; nog says the check continues. Neither clause is a perfect construction.
My colleague has documented the change in the ticket.
Your colleague documented the change in the ticket. Report where it was recorded.
Heeft vastgelegd is perfect with separable vastleggen. Mijn collega is the singular subject; in het ticket identifies the recording location.
Before the meeting, we had collected all the answers.
All answers had already been collected before the meeting began. Place that completed collection before the past meeting.
Hadden verzameld is the past perfect, earlier than the past meeting. The fronted phrase vóór de vergadering is followed by hadden we; All the answers are included.
We hadden vóór de vergadering alle antwoorden verzameld.
Before the meeting, we had collected all the answers.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
Which parts have you already tested?
You need to know which parts your colleagues have already tested. Ask the group directly.
Welke onderdelen is the fronted question object; jullie is the plural subject of hebben. Al means already and getest completes the perfect bracket.
S=Ik|V=wacht|PP=op de goedkeuring van de beheerder.
I am waiting for the administrator's approval.
Your work is waiting for approval from the administrator. Name that dependency in the meeting.
Wachten takes op for what is awaited. Van de beheerder identifies whose approval is needed; the sentence does not say approval has been given.
Without a test account, we cannot continue.
Your team cannot continue without a test account. Explain what is preventing progress.
Zonder testaccount is fronted, so kunnen precedes we. Niet negates the ability to continue; verdergaan stays a joined infinitive without te after kunnen.
We kunnen zonder testaccount niet verdergaan.
Without a test account, we cannot continue.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
The schedule is slipping because the data is missing.
Missing data is making the schedule slip. Explain the reason for the delay.
Uitlopen splits as loopt ... uit. Omdat introduces the cause; de gegevens is plural, taking ontbreken at the clause's end.
Can someone help me with this error code?
An error code is blocking your work. Ask the team whether someone can help you with it.
Kan precedes subject iemand. Mij is the person helped, a direct object of helpen; met deze foutcode identifies the issue for which help is requested.
The technical check is not the blocker.
Colleagues think the technical check is the blocker, but that is incorrect. Correct that assumption.
Niet negates identifying the technical check as de blokkade. De blokkade is a noun complement after is, not an object receiving an action.
We are still missing the supplier's confirmation.
Your team is still missing confirmation from the supplier. Name that remaining external dependency.
Missen is finite with we. Nog marks the continuing absence; van de leverancier identifies the source of the confirmation being awaited.
As long as access is missing, the test remains blocked.
The test cannot proceed while access remains unavailable. State how long that blocker persists.
Zolang introduces a continuing condition. Its whole clause comes before main-clause blijft de test; geblokkeerd describes the continuing blocked state.
I am not allowed to carry out the change without permission.
You need permission before carrying out a change. Explain that you are not allowed to proceed without it.
Mag concerns permission rather than technical ability. Niet zonder toestemming prohibits carrying out the change without authorisation; uitvoeren stays infinitive without te.
The team needs someone who can remove the current blocker. Ask who is able to do that.
Wie is the question subject. Kan is the modal and wegnemen remains a joined infinitive; the question asks about ability rather than reporting a completed fix.
The missing manual delays the preparation.
Preparation is delayed because the manual is missing. Explain that dependency to colleagues.
De ontbrekende handleiding is the singular subject of vertraagt. Ontbrekende describes the missing manual; de voorbereiding is what is delayed.
May I ask a question about this?
You want to ask about the point currently being discussed. Politely ask permission to raise your question.
Mag ik asks permission. Hier ... over is a split referring adverb meaning about this; een vraag is the object of stellen. Hier does not indicate a time.
I have something to add to that point.
A colleague has made a point and you have a related addition. Introduce that addition.
Heb is a main verb here, not a perfect auxiliary. Een aanvulling op dat punt means something added about that particular point.
S=Ik|V=begrijp|NEG=niet helemaal|G=wat je met beschikbaar bedoelt.
I do not fully understand what you mean by available.
A colleague uses available in a way you do not fully understand. Explain your partial uncertainty.
Niet helemaal means not fully, leaving partial understanding possible. Wat introduces the embedded question; je is its subject and bedoelt is final.
Can we stay with the planning for a moment?
The discussion has drifted away from planning. Ask the group to stay on that topic briefly.
Kunnen we is a joint request. Bij de planning blijven means stay with that topic; even softens the request rather than giving an exact duration.
I have a different question about that.
You have a different question about the same topic. Introduce it while referring back to the discussion.
Daarover means about that and is fronted, followed by heb ik. Een andere vraag changes the question, while the topic referred to stays the same.
Can you explain the difference with an example?
A distinction remains unclear to you. Ask a colleague informally to explain it through an example.
Kun precedes je. Met een voorbeeld gives the method of explaining; uitleggen stays joined as an infinitive after the modal.
I am not sure whether we mean the same thing.
You suspect a misunderstanding about what the group means. Say that you are unsure whether everyone means the same thing.
Of introduces whether. Hetzelfde is what we mean and bedoelen comes at the clause's end; niet zeker describes uncertainty rather than definite disagreement.
From the support perspective, we see another risk.
Your support team sees an additional risk in the proposal. Add that perspective to the discussion.
Vanuit de ondersteuning is a fronted perspective phrase, followed by zien we. Nog een risico means another risk; it does not specify the total count.
We zien vanuit de ondersteuning nog een risico.
From the support perspective, we see another risk.

Let's discuss this point after the break.
You want the group to discuss this point after the break. Make that joint proposal.
Laten we introduces a proposal including the speaker. Bespreken stays infinitive without te, and na de pauze sets the proposed discussion time.
What does that mean for the users?
A proposal may affect users. Ask what that proposal means for them.
Wat asks about the implications. Dat is the subject of betekent, referring to the proposal; voor de gebruikers identifies the affected people, not a deadline.
The group has reached an agreement, but you need its exact terms. Ask what was agreed.
Hebben afgesproken forms the perfect. Wat is the question object, we the subject, and precies asks for the agreement's exact content.
I record the decision in the minutes.
The group reached a decision and you will record it in the minutes. Say where you are putting it.
Noteer is present and can announce the immediate recording action. Het besluit is the object; in het verslag names the written record.
This is still a proposal, not a final decision.
A proposal is being discussed, but no final decision has been reached. Clarify its status.
Nog means still. Een voorstel and geen definitief besluit are noun complements after is; the contrast separates a proposal from a final decision.
S=We|AUX=hebben|PT=besloten|TE=om de test een dag uit te stellen.
We have decided to postpone the test by a day.
Your team decided to move the test one day later. Report that decision without claiming the test has already happened.
Hebben besloten is perfect. Om introduces the decided action, not a purpose in this sentence; uitstellen places te between uit and stellen. Een dag gives the postponement's extent.
Can you confirm the agreement in writing?
You need written confirmation of the agreement. Ask a colleague informally to provide it.
Kun precedes je and bevestigen remains infinitive. Schriftelijk means in writing and describes how confirmation should be given, not when.
L=In het verslag|V=ontbreekt|S=de reden voor het uitstel.
The reason for the postponement is missing from the minutes.
The minutes omit the reason for postponement. Point out what is missing from that record.
In het verslag is fronted. De reden voor het uitstel is the singular subject of ontbreekt; voor het uitstel explains which reason, not a deadline.
De reden voor het uitstel ontbreekt in het verslag.
The reason for the postponement is missing from the minutes.

I check whether the minutes accurately reflect our decision.
You are checking whether the minutes accurately reflect your team's decision. Describe that accuracy review.
Of introduces a whether-question. Het verslag is its subject; ons matches singular het besluit. Weergeeft stays joined at the end of the embedded clause.
The team leader has not approved the proposal yet.
The team leader has not yet approved the proposal. State that approval remains pending.
Heeft goedgekeurd is perfect with separable goedkeuren. Nog niet means not yet; it does not claim the proposal can never be approved.
Which date is now in the minutes?
The meeting record contains a date that needs checking. Ask which date is currently written there.
Welke datum is itself the question subject, taking staat. Nu limits the question to the current record; in het verslag gives its location.
If everyone agrees, we will record the agreement.
The group will record the agreement only if everyone agrees. State that condition.
Als introduces the condition and iedereen is singular with is. The fronted clause is followed by leggen we; vastleggen splits as leggen ... vast.
I will send the action list after the meeting.
You will send the action list after the meeting. Take responsibility for that follow-up.
Zal is finite with ik, while versturen stays infinitive. Na het overleg means after the meeting, not a deadline before it.
Na het overleg zal ik de actielijst versturen.
I will send the action list after the meeting.

Who will take on checking the documentation?
The documentation review needs an owner. Ask who will take responsibility for checking it.
Wie is the question subject. Op zich nemen means take upon oneself; zich refers back to the person identified by wie, and de controle is the responsibility taken on.
We arrange a short feedback session for Friday.
Your team is arranging a short feedback session for Friday. State that arrangement.
Afspreken splits as spreken ... af. Voor vrijdag means scheduled for Friday in this arrangement; it is not automatically a deadline before Friday.
The owner must update the status before Thursday.
The action owner must update the status before Thursday. State that deadline.
Moet agrees with singular de eigenaar and bijwerken stays infinitive. Voor donderdag sets the deadline for the update, rather than the day on which it is scheduled.
Voor donderdag moet de eigenaar de status bijwerken.
The owner must update the status before Thursday.

S=Ik|V=bevestig|G=dat ik de gebruiker morgen bel.
I confirm that I will call the user tomorrow.
You commit to calling the user tomorrow. Confirm that specific next-day action.
Dat introduces the commitment's content. Morgen gives bel a future reading despite its present form; ik is the subject of both bevestig and bel.
This action does not have an owner yet.
An action still has no assigned owner. Flag that unassigned responsibility at the meeting.
Heeft is a main verb expressing possession, not a perfect auxiliary. Nog geen eigenaar means no owner yet, leaving later assignment possible.
Can you collect the test results by Tuesday?
You need a colleague to gather the test results by Tuesday. Ask them directly whether they can do it.
Kun precedes emphatic subject jij. Tegen dinsdag gives the intended by-Tuesday deadline; verzamelen stays an infinitive without te.
We have assigned the follow-up to one colleague.
Your team assigned follow-up to one colleague. Report that completed allocation of responsibility.
Hebben toegewezen is perfect with separable toewijzen. Aan één collega identifies the recipient and emphasises one colleague, rather than an unspecified group.
G=Zodra de controle klaar is,|V=stuurt|S=de eigenaar|O=een update.
As soon as the check is complete, the owner sends an update.
The owner should send an update as soon as the check is complete. State that trigger.
Zodra means as soon as, and klaar is ends its clause. The complete clause comes first, followed by stuurt de eigenaar in the main clause.
When do we review the outstanding actions again?
The group needs another review of its outstanding actions. Ask when that review will happen.
Wanneer is the question word, followed by finite bekijken and subject we. Opnieuw means again; openstaande describes actions that remain outstanding.
